scope: Construction of one explicitly selected village pressure-water network VWS-HDPE-PE100-RC-OD160-110-4200 with 3000 m of OD160 PE100 SDR17 main, 1200 m of OD110 PE100 SDR17 branches, 36 valve chambers, 18 fire hydrants and 150 explicit house-service connection stubs. Direct survey, trench, bedding, pipe, fittings, valves, chambers, backfill, thrust blocks, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved village water-supply design, hydraulic calculation, longitudinal profiles, pipe-valve-chamber-hydrant schedules, house-service register, geotechnical report, hydraulic-test and disinfection program, suppliers and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: source intake, borehole, pumping or treatment station, reservoir, water tower, internal plumbing or unrelated sewer scope
trench, bedding, valves, chambers, hydrants, connections, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from total length, flow or diameter
automatic rock excavation, groundwater dewatering, traffic management or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-bundle length
